scope: Broad manufacturing capability families, with bounded executable workflows and explicit remaining work. No Fusion-wide parity, machine certification or physical manufacturing claim.

evidence.command: PYTHONPATH=src O3D_CURA_ENGINE=<CuraEngine> O3D_CURA_DEFINITIONS=<definitions> python -m pytest -q tests/test_manufacturing.py

external_engines.name: CuraEngine

Combined modes, live tooling, clamping/transfer state, subspindle coordination and machine qualification
